messages.english: Length unit
messages.translation: Yuniti ya vhulapfu

messages.english: Metres (m)
messages.translation: Dzimithara (m)

messages.english: Feet (ft)
messages.translation: Dzifithi / Feet (ft)

messages.english: Use decimal numbers with a dot or comma; either is a decimal separator. No digit grouping, fractions or unit suffixes. Direction stays in degrees. Switching units changes entry and display only; saved dimensions remain in metres.
messages.translation: Shumisani nomboro dza desimali dzi re na tshiga tsha tshithoma kana khoma; tshithihi kha zwenezwo ndi tshifhandekanyi tsha desimali (decimal separator). A hu na u kuvhanganya nomboro (digit grouping), zwipida (fractions) kana mitshila ya dziyuniti. Sia (direction) li dzula li nga dzi-degrees. U shandukisa dziyuniti zwi shandukisa u dzhenisa na u sumbedzwa fhedzi; mielo yo vhulungwaho i dzula i nga dzimithara.

messages.english: Your current entries keep their original unit. Choose a unit explicitly to change it.
messages.translation: Zwe na dzhenisa zwino zwi dzula na yuniti yazwo ya u thoma. Nangani yuniti nga u tou bvisela khagala u itela u i shandukisa.

messages.english: Unit choice remembered on this device.
messages.translation: Khetho ya yuniti yo humbulwa kha tshishumiswa itshi.

messages.english: Unit choice applies only to this sample session.
messages.translation: Khetho ya yuniti i shuma kha tshifhinga itshi tsha tsumbo (sample session) fhedzi.

messages.english: Unit choice works here, but could not be remembered on this device.
messages.translation: Khetho ya yuniti i a shuma afha, fhedzi a yo ngo kona u humbulwa kha tshishumiswa itshi.

messages.english: Complete valid decimal dimensions before changing units. Your entries and their current unit have been kept.
messages.translation: Fhedzani mielo ya desimali yo tendelwaho ni sa athu shandukisa dziyuniti. Zwe na dzhenisa na yuniti yazwo ya zwino zwi kha ḓi vha hone kha fomo.

messages.english: The account or sample context changed. Reopen the design to load its field settings.
messages.translation: Nyimele ya akhaunthu kana ya tsumbo yo shanduka. Vulani hafhu nyolo u itela u dzhenisa ndudzanyo dza tsimu yayo.

messages.english: Checking the account or sample context before showing field settings.
messages.translation: Hu khou sedzuluswa nyimele ya akhaunthu kana ya tsumbo hu sa athu sumbedzwa ndudzanyo dza tsimu.

messages.english: The saved field, map scale or account context changed. Your draft has been kept. Reload the field settings before applying.
messages.translation: Tsimu yo vhulungwaho, tshikalo tsha mapa (map scale) kana nyimele ya akhaunthu yo shanduka. Mvetomveto yaṋu (draft) i kha ḓi vha hone kha fomo. Dzhenisani hafhu ndudzanyo dza tsimu ni sa athu shumisa.

messages.english: Complete valid decimal bed and path dimensions before applying.
messages.translation: Fhedzani mielo ya desimali yo tendelwaho ya mmbete ya u ṱavha (beds) na dziḽila ni sa athu shumisa.

messages.english: Reload field settings
messages.translation: Dzhenisani hafhu ndudzanyo dza tsimu

messages.english: The field or account context changed. Reload the field settings before applying.
messages.translation: Nyimele ya tsimu kana ya akhaunthu yo shanduka. Dzhenisani hafhu ndudzanyo dza tsimu ni sa athu shumisa.

messages.english: Enter field-block bed and path dimensions in metres or feet.
messages.translation: Dzhenisani mielo ya mmbete ya u ṱavha (beds) na dziḽila dza buḽoko ya tsimu nga dzimithara kana dzifithi (feet).

messages.english: Keep saved measurements unchanged when switching the displayed unit.
messages.translation: Vhulungani mielo yo vhulungwaho i songo shanduka musi ni tshi shandukisa yuniti i sumbedzwaho.

messages.english: Choose field-block units
messages.translation: Nangani dziyuniti dza buḽoko ya tsimu

messages.english: Site design → Planting → Field blocks
messages.translation: Nyolo ya fhethu → U ṱavha → Dzibuḽoko dza tsimu

messages.english: Select a field, choose metres or feet, enter your dimensions and review the beds before saving. Open fields keep their polygon area without generating beds.
messages.translation: Nangani tsimu, nangani dzimithara kana dzifithi (feet), dzhenisani mielo yaṋu uri ni sedzuluse mmbete ya u ṱavha (beds) ni sa athu vhulunga. Masimu o vuleaho a vhulunga vhupo hao ha polygon hu si na u bveledza mmbete ya u ṱavha (beds).
